visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and glasses holds a young boy in a blue t-shirt and tan shorts. They stand outdoors in front of a white corrugated metal wall under bright, direct sunlight. The man wears a black shirt and a yellow cross-body bag. (2) Three capybaras are shown from a high angle, soaking in a rectangular concrete water pool. Their brown fur is saturated with water. (3) A young girl in a pink shirt and green sandals stands on a wooden walkway, holding a long green grass stalk toward a capybara behind a glass barrier. (4) The boy stands alone on a gravel path, waving his right hand toward the camera with a neutral expression. (5) A black goat with long ears reaches over a wooden fence to take grass from the children's hands. The man supports the boy as he watches. (6) In a donkey enclosure, the girl in pink holds a cup of orange carrot sticks. The boy tentatively holds a single carrot stick toward a donkey's mouth while the man assists him. (7) The boy is shown crying and walking quickly away on a stone-paved path while a capybara follows him closely on the ground. A long green leaf lies on the ground between them. (8) The man holds the boy while feeding a carrot to a white and brown alpaca. The boy looks slightly apprehensive but remains calm in the man's arms. (9) The boy stands on a gravel path holding a carrot stick close to his chest. He has a distressed facial expression and is crying, seemingly reluctant to share the food. (10) The boy slowly extends the carrot toward a small deer through a metal fence. He looks sad but compliant with the adult's instructions. (11) The screen turns pink with a central cartoon illustration of a girl holding a peach, followed by branding text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male voice narrates over a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar track at approximately 105 BPM. The music is cheerful and sets a positive tone. (2) Ambient sounds of an outdoor space and footsteps on gravel are heard as a young girl's high-pitched voice expresses excitement about animals. (3) The acoustic guitar continues as background music while the children's voices rise in volume during animal interactions. (4) A child's loud crying begins, indicating high arousal and distress, accompanied by the sound of adults trying to comfort him. (5) SFX of clapping and a bright chime are heard when the child successfully interacts with an animal. (6) The adult male voice adopts a soft, persuasive tone to explain the feeding rules to the children. (7) The video concludes with the music fading out gently under a short closing jingle.
